name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
role: U.S. Representative for New York's 14th district (2019–)
summary: A Democratic member of Congress and member of the Democratic Socialists of America, she advocates a large expansion of public programs: single-payer health care, a federal jobs guarantee and the Green New Deal. She favors higher taxes on top earners, stronger unions, cuts to police and military budgets, and expansive immigrant, LGBTQ and abortion rights, while describing her socialism as democratic and compatible with markets.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Campaign platform calls for Medicare for All single-payer coverage; she describes health care as a human right.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Backs a $15 federal minimum wage, ending the tipped subminimum, and indexing to inflation.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Called capitalism an ideology of capital and criticized profit-driven allocation, while also saying market economies can coexist with democratic socialism.

public-ownership.rationale: Green New Deal resolution asks for public ownership stakes in supported projects, public banks and community ownership; no explicit call found to nationalize energy, rail or utilities.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Proposed a top marginal rate of up to 70% on income above $10 million; campaigned on 'Tax the Rich'.

unions-good.rationale: Platform calls for repealing Taft-Hartley, fining union-busting and steering federal contracts to unionized firms; GND calls for strengthening the right to organize.

property-fundamental.rationale: Supports rent-increase caps on larger landlords and cancelling vulture-fund debt in Puerto Rico, implying property rights may be overridden for social goals; no direct statement on property as a right.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Calls for curbing pharmaceutical price gouging and monopolies, conditions on corporate aid, and a market free of domination by monopolies.

cut-welfare.rationale: Seeks to extend safety-net programs to undocumented immigrants and people with convictions and opposes Medicaid cuts.

worker-ownership.rationale: Promotes worker cooperatives as part of her democratic-socialist vision, without calling for all firms to be worker-owned.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Opposes the EARN IT Act and other expansions of state powers she sees as threatening civil liberties; no detailed record on counter-terror surveillance was reviewed.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Only evidence reviewed is legislation easing research on medical psilocybin; no position on general recreational legalization found in the sources read.

strong-leader.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources reviewed.

state-harmful.rationale: Her whole program relies on an expanded state role (single-payer health care, jobs guarantee, Green New Deal).

limit-guns.rationale: Supports an assault-weapons and high-capacity-magazine ban, universal background checks and red-flag laws; voted for the 2022 gun safety law.

empower-police-military.rationale: Advocated divesting from and cutting police budgets and reducing Pentagon spending.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Platform calls for repealing SESTA/FOSTA, which sex-worker advocates oppose; no explicit call for legalization found.

decide-locally.rationale: No recorded general position found; her major proposals are national programs.

rehabilitation.rationale: Supports ending life without parole, mandatory minimums, solitary confinement and cash bail, expanding Pell Grants for prisoners and keeping benefits for people re-entering society.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Supports the Equality Act and broad LGBTQ legal protections, which clearly implies support for legal same-sex marriage.

abortion-legal.rationale: Treats abortion as health care, supports codifying abortion rights and belongs to the Pro-Choice Caucus.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Criticized redlining in New Deal policy and sponsored a Green New Deal centered on repairing harm to frontline and historically oppressed communities.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Supports transgender rights, but no statement found on whether gender is primarily a social construct.

gradual-change.rationale: Pushes for rapid, large-scale change (a ten-year Green New Deal mobilization, abolishing ICE and the Electoral College, expanding the Supreme Court), though she works within the legislature.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Supports abolishing ICE, decriminalizing border crossing and a path to citizenship; no explicit statement on overall immigration levels found.

free-trade.rationale: GND calls for trade rules and border adjustments to stop offshoring of jobs, but she also called Trump's tariffs disastrous; mixed record.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Calls for ending 'forever wars' and air strikes and opposed the Saudi-led Yemen intervention, while supporting aid to Ukraine; no general statement on humanitarian intervention.

open-borders.rationale: Favors abolishing ICE and a path to citizenship, but no statement found supporting open borders.

limit-growth.rationale: Her climate program stresses prosperity and job creation; no position on limiting growth found.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Lead sponsor of the Green New Deal resolution calling for a ten-year national mobilization to reach net-zero emissions.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Has said she is open-minded about nuclear power in the Green New Deal, without backing expansion.

central-planning.rationale: Rejects state socialism as undemocratic and easily corrupted and says markets can coexist with democratic socialism.

socialized-markets.rationale: Says markets are compatible with democratic socialism and cites cooperatives, but does not make worker or public ownership a condition for markets.

tax-inheritance.rationale: No position on estate taxes found in the sources reviewed.

basic-income.rationale: She favors a federal jobs guarantee; no position on unconditional basic income found.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: GND seeks trade rules and border adjustments to protect domestic manufacturing, but she called Trump's tariffs disastrous.

state-directs-investment.rationale: The Green New Deal she sponsored calls for large public investment in clean industry, manufacturing and infrastructure, with public banks and public stakes.

one-party-rule.rationale: Rejects state socialism as undemocratic and frames her politics as democratic socialism working within elections.

democracy-best.rationale: Frames her politics around extending democracy, including calls to abolish the Electoral College so every vote counts equally.

right-to-secede.rationale: Supports self-determination for Puerto Rico, a territory, but no general position on regions' right to secede found.

military-superiority.rationale: Calls for cutting Pentagon spending and large weapons programs and shifting money to diplomacy; no direct statement on military superiority.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Calls for undocumented residents to become full members of society and frames immigrants as part of the nation, which clearly implies rejecting an ethnically defined nation.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Her Green New Deal resolution calls for free, prior and informed consent of Indigenous peoples, honoring treaties and protecting their sovereignty and land rights.

algorithmic-government.rationale: No recorded position found; she has criticized AI data centers on environmental grounds only.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Platform opposes the EARN IT Act, which critics said would weaken encryption; no direct statement on encryption found.

notes: Born October 13, 1989; living and serving in Congress as of 2026. Her record is detailed on economic, social-policy and climate questions but silent on many of the test's philosophical and fringe-ideology statements, so those are left null rather than inferred from her party or self-description. Her views on capitalism are mixed: she called it irredeemable in 2019 but also says markets are compatible with democratic socialism.
